messages:
SRE-bot: PagerDuty alert: elevated 5xx rate hitting api.redwood.example from eu-west region. initial spike started ~5m ago. auto-scale triggered but latencies > 2s for many tokens. tagging as incident, paging oncall.
pagerduty: Paging maria (SRE on-call). please acknowledge.
maria: ack. i'm on it. grabbing overview dashboards and runbook.
maria: quick summary from observability: 5xx are largely 502/503 from external provider A (provider-a) in eu-west, upstream failures causing request queueing -> backpressure. traffic from that region is ~35% of global qps right now.
maria: setting incident role: IC. jake, can you join for runtime-level mitigations?
jake: joining. oncall-eng-runtime. i can take action on routing and feature toggles.
liam: hey team — cs reporting 3 customers with degraded generation output (truncated responses). severity P1 for a couple mid-market customers.
anita: product-ops here — we need to decide whether to brownout long-context and streaming to reduce GPU pressure.
sophie: support here, notifying impacted customers. sending initial template: "we're mitigating elevated errors in EU, we may route traffic to alternate regions/provider and there may be temporary degraded features".
eng-runtime: recommended immediate mitigations: 1) soft throttle new sessions from eu-west at edge (rate-limit per-IP/customer) 2) shift region routing policy to prefer provider-b for eu-west 3) disable streaming and long-context (>8k) for non-enterprise plans.
maria: prioritize mitigations in order: low-risk first. let's start with traffic shaping + rate limiting and enable provider fallback.
jake: starting with route weight change. pushing config to routing service (canary to 5% then 100% if good). command:
```bash
# increase provider-b weight for eu-west
curl -X POST https://routing.redwood.internal/update -d '{"region":"eu-west","provider_weights":{"provider-b":0.6,"provider-a":0.4}}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $ROUTER_TOKEN"
```
jake: canaryed 5% -> initial health checks look fine. latencies slightly better for those canary flows.
maria: enabling edge soft throttle for new session starts from eu-west. policy: per-customer token-bucket 30 rps for free/small accounts, 200 rps for enterprise. applying now.
eng-runtime: applied throttle rules. sample Edge config snippet:
```yaml
edge-rate-limit:
  region: eu-west
  default_rps: 30
  enterprise_rps: 200
  burst: 100
```
liam: CS: customers seeing partial improvements, some report retries succeed. keep me in loop.
anita: preparing brownout toggle but holding for now. want to see routing + throttle impact.
infra-lead: FYI, provider-b has capacity headroom but different cost profile — finance notified.
jake: canary ramp to 40% now. errors in canary traffic are down ~60%, p95 latency down ~600ms.
maria: good. continue ramp to 100% over next 10m unless we see regression. we also need a plan B: region drain for eu-west if provider-b also degrades.
eng-runtime: plan B steps sketched in runbook: 1) set per-region denylist for provider-a 2) apply region-level failover -> route all eu-west to eu-central (latency penalty but more stable) 3) execute partial drain of non-critical routes (batch jobs, low-tier inference).
jake: rolling to 100% provider-b now. monitoring.
SRE-bot: incident timeline updated, incident channel pinned.
maria: while we observe, let's proactively lower quota limits for new free tenants to reduce load. command i've triggered (admin-api):
```bash
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood.internal/quotas/adjust -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"scope":"free-tier","generation_tokens_per_minute":1000}'
```
maria: lowering took effect. eng-runtime please confirm quotas reflected in CDN/edge.
eng-runtime: confirmed, throttle + quota changes visible in telemetry. request volume from free-tier down ~22%.
sophie: customers on enterprise unaffected by quota cut. CS prepping tailored comms.
liam: impacted customers list updated in incident doc. adding timeline to ticket.
anita: decision: do not brownout user-visible features yet. hold unless provider-b degrades. product-ops prefers to avoid disabling streaming for paying customers.
infra-lead: i'm seeing backend worker queue length drop after provider swap and quotas. good trend.
maria: next: schedule handoff. jake will handle post-mitigation monitoring for next 90m, then hand to jake-night (on rotation). i will remain IC for follow-up RCA. jake, confirm takeover in 10m.
jake: confirmed. i'll post final status update when we hit 1h stable or earlier if regress.
SRE-bot: note: initiating rate-limit telemetry burn-in for 15m to validate no unintended denials.
eng-runtime: quick checklist to escalate to region drain if we see provider-b error rate > 1% for 15m or global p95 spikes > 1.5s:
- remove provider-a route entirely for eu-west
- run drain jobs: 
```bash
kubectl cordon node-eu-west-01 && kubectl drain node-eu-west-01 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```
- adjust autoscaler configs for eu-central to absorb extra qps
- open customer ops war room
```
# routing: full failover
curl -X POST https://routing.redwood.internal/update -d '{"region":"eu-west","failover_region":"eu-central","force_failover":true}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $ROUTER_TOKEN"
```
maria: logging playbook entries for whichever path we take. also notify legal/compliance if we do cross-region failover for regulated customers.
cs-bot: Notifying affected customers group. Email batch queued.
SRE-bot: Metrics: provider-a 5xx spikes back to baseline after weight shift? small blips but healthy.
jake: at 100% provider-b routing now for eu-west. observed stable for 12m. no significant customer complaints in last 10m.
maria: lowering priority: close incident if stable for next 30m and prepare RCA. next steps: gather logs, kernel metrics, and provider-a postmortem request.
liam: CS will follow up with impacted customers with timeline and mitigation details.
anita: product-ops: will open a change to add stricter provider health gating to avoid automatic route to failing provider-a in future.
jake: handing monitoring to next oncall (jake-night). I'll post handoff note in 10m with summary.
maria: IC signing off active mitigation. remaining actions: RCA, provider follow-up, update runbooks with throttle thresholds.
SRE-bot: incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. closing pager.
jake: handoff: maria -> jake (active monitoring). leaving a short checklist in the thread.
maria: thanks all. great run.
SRE-bot: Incident closed as 'mitigated' at 1796002222 on metrics stable for 20m. Postmortem owner assigned: maria.
